$comment: The ONE file in qf-atlas a human edits by hand. Everything else is generated.
Maps a finding id (from atlas.json) to what you decided about it.
Anything not listed here counts as 'undecided'.
repair    real, scheduled -> becomes a work order
remove    confirmed dead -> becomes a deletion batch
accepted  known debt you are living with. REQUIRES why, owner and expires,
or it does not count as a decision and stays undecided.
All clear means undecided == 0. It does not mean zero findings: some coverage
gaps are unparseable without a compiler, and some debt is deliberate.
Ids are semantic, so they survive edits inside a file. Renaming a file or
moving the SQL retires the old id and raises a fresh undecided one, which is
correct: code that moved deserves another look.
PROPOSED 2026-08-17 by the atlas-delete-authority pass. Every verdict below
carries the evidence it was drawn from. Findings NOT listed here are left
undecided on purpose: they need per-item verification or founder intent, and a
guessed verdict is worse than an honest blank.
2026-08-17 expunge: the four remove verdicts were executed and their findings no longer exist, so their entries were pruned. The reasoning lives in the commit that deleted them.

unreachable:collab-electron/src/main/a2a.why: GATE-ANCHORED. qa/gates/artifact-root/run.ts:350 reads this exact path, and :359/:362 assert it imports AND calls the production A2A artifact store. Deleting it turns a gate red, which is the one thing this work may never do to make the map greener.

unreachable:collab-electron/src/windows/.why: Founder-authored brand engine. qa/gates/one-skin.ts:21 allowlists this exact path as one of two justified palette exceptions, and WO-007 describes it as imported verbatim as founder input. flow-cube-watermark.js does not import it (the apparent import at line 16 is a usage comment), so 'unimported' is accurate and irrelevant: it is an asset, not dead wiring.

broken-bridge-call:ptyForegroundProcess.why: REAL RUNTIME DEFECT in a live window. terminal IS a build input, and terminal/src/App.tsx:202 awaits window.api.ptyForegroundProcess(session.id), which neither preload exposes — it throws TypeError when that path runs. Verified pre-existing at d543b01, so atlas-strip-1 did not cause it; removing the orphaned pty:foreground-process main handler was correct. Fix is to restore the preload method or drop the call site.
